summary: Security specialist S1 promoted: session cookie lacks HttpOnly and Secure on the auth path.

verification_assessment.note: Defect shown by Set-Cookie literal; specialist report S1 promoted to F1 after independent static confirmation.

findings.trigger: Issue a session after login and inspect Set-Cookie.
findings.expected: Session cookie includes HttpOnly, Secure, and SameSite.
findings.impact: XSS can steal the session cookie; cleartext exposure risk if TLS is misconfigured.
findings.fix: Add HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax or Strict.
findings.evidence_detail: Set-Cookie string has no HttpOnly or Secure. Promoted from specialist S1 after confirming quote in supplied source.

what_held_up: Session token is taken from a server-side helper rather than a client-supplied raw id in the supplied snippet.
open_questions: Does the production TLS terminator add cookie flags? This is not established by the supplied packet.

constraints: Limit the change to cookie attribute flags unless tests require a helper.
stop_conditions: F1: Set-Cookie on login includes HttpOnly and Secure; a test or static quote shows both attributes.
